description: RISC-V RV64 scalar subset experiment, generic-rv64 with +m,+zmmul,+zbb baked into the oracle. Custom: 32-bit ADD/SUB/shifts, 64-bit constants, 32-bit div/rem, 32-bit rotate, 32-bit clz/ctz, 64-bit abs. Libcall: 128-bit div/rem and srem. Lower: carry/saturating/overflow, no-P/no-Zbkb/no-Zbkc leftovers, abs family, min/max, compare, divrem, and the unreachable clz/ctz fallback.
